content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by Disclosing Party that is marked as confidential or is otherwise agreed to be confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until all Confidential Information has been made public through no fault of Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 28th day of February 2024.
